brief.title: Three steps to a clear message
brief.narration: Start with one useful idea. Explain why it matters in a short sentence. Give your audience a practical next step. Keep each scene focused so the message is easy to follow.
brief.caption: One idea. A clear explanation. A useful next step.

scenes.title: Choose one idea
scenes.body: Focus on one useful message for your audience.

scenes.title: Explain the benefit
scenes.body: Use a short sentence and a concrete example.

scenes.title: Offer a next step
scenes.body: Finish with one action the viewer can take.
